messages:
Maya (Marketing): Quick check — final logistics for Thursday's virtual launch workshop. Need greenroom host, Zoom config, recording owner, and post-event follow-up cadence. Can everyone confirm by EOD? :raised_hands:

Jon (Events): Greenroom reserved 30m before start. I'll be the greenroom host. Zoom link created and shared in the calendar invite. No RTMP unless we need broadcast fallback — do we?

Priya (Ops): Reg page updated: timezone auto-detect + capacity limit 500. HubSpot form mapped to list `webinar_signups_launch_apr`. Also added a hidden field `utm_experiment=benchmark_v1`.

Sam (Growth): HubSpot -> Zapier -> Segment mapping ready. Suggest mapping `hs_email` -> `email`, `company` -> `org_name`, `interest_topic` -> `lead_tag`. Planning SFDC push: lead -> Campaign 'Launch-April-2026'.

Ethan (Content): Recording owner? I'll package clips and 1-pager. Please tag clip requests in the assets channel with `event:launch-apr`. Whoever downloads recording, please cc me.

Maya (Marketing): Host/co-hosts: host = @Jon, co-hosts = @Maya, @Priya, @Ethan. Greenroom run order: 1) mic/camera check 2) slides pass 3) backup demo 4) roll call. Please run through this snippet in greenroom:```
Zoom settings:
- Cloud recording: ON (host recording)
- Auto-record: enabled to cloud
- Waiting room: OFF (we'll manage via registration)
- Mute participants on entry: ON
- Allow participants to unmute: OFF until Q&A
- Co-hosts: jon@example.com, maya@example.com, priya@example.com
- Alternate hosts: N/A
```

Priya (Ops): Also set cloud recording retention to 30 days and enable download permission for host only. I'll add a note in the calendar invite with download instructions.

Sam (Growth): Post-event email cadence (draft):
- Immediate (within 1 hour): Replay + 1-pager + CTA to book a demo. Subject: "Replay + key takeaways from our launch"
- Day 3: Benchmark deep-dive blog + short clip (metrics TL;DR: ~2x latency improvement, ~40% unit cost reduction vs baseline)
- Day 10: Nurture: product use cases + invite to office hours
Map these to HubSpot workflows: `replay_send`, `benchmarks_drip`, `nurture_10d`.

Ethan (Content): I'll prep the 1-pager and the 2-min highlight clip. ETA: Wed 5pm. Need the raw recording access by Fri 10am for edits.

Jon (Events): Reminder: live captions enabled and transcript export on. We should also pin the slide PDF in the Zoom chat at start.

ZoomBot: Recording scheduled to start automatically when host joins. Cloud recording storage: enabled.

Maya (Marketing): Small checklist for action owners: Priya — confirm HubSpot list + form mapping; Jon — greenroom host + pin slides; Ethan — clip ownership; Sam — workflow creation; I'll finalize the email templates tonight and share. Please react with :thumbsup: when done.

Priya (Ops): Confirmed mapping + retention settings. :white_check_mark:

Jon (Events): Greenroom and slides pinned. I'll run the run-through Thurs 30m prior. :rocket:

Ethan (Content): Recording access note: granting to `ethan@example.com` and `maya@example.com`. I'll queue edits after download. :clapper:

Sam (Growth): Workflows created in draft. Will hand off to Maya for final copy. :gear:

Maya (Marketing): Great — thanks all. If anything blocks, drop here or DM.

Maya (Marketing): P.S. small reminder for messaging: call out 'predictable latency' and 'cost per token savings' in the replay email subject line A/B test.

Jon (Events): Noted. See you in the greenroom.

ZoomBot: Host Jon joined the meeting. Recording started at 2024-04-04 16:00:12 UTC.
